title: Beyond Yoga x HOUSEWORK: Sculpt
description: Move, sweat, and breathe together with Beyond Yoga at our NYC Flatiron pop-up store!
long_description:
Move, sweat, and breathe together with Beyond Yoga at our NYC Flatiron pop-up store!

About this Event

Beyond Yoga is bringing Club Beyond to NYC! Come move with us in our pop-up store in Flatiron!
Join Beyond Yoga and HOUSEWORK at our Club Beyond studio for a HOUSEWORK Sculpt class
HOUSEWORK Sculpt
You've never sculpted like this before! This is a 45-minute low impact workout focused on burning out each muscle group through beat based choreography all set to a playlist that makes you feel like you're moving through a DJ set. This class is designed to feel seamless, intuitive and easy to follow while still delivering our signature HOUSEWORK choreo and burn! Make sure to wear sneakers.
Instructor: Melissa Z

All attendees will receive a voucher for a FREE Spacedye™ Caught In The Midi High Waisted Legging or Spacedye™ Unlimited Men's Short in Darkest Night. You will have until December 13th 2026 to redeem the voucher. We can’t wait to see you there!
The Beyond Yoga pop-up store is located at 108 5th Ave NY, NY 10011
One purchase per person.

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in New York, Workshops in New York.
